check_out_success.doc: Stripe Checkout success return. UX-only: redirects the browser to the desk. Entitlement is applied by the payment.webhook service; the FE plan updates via the WS payment.plan_updated event.

session_id.doc: Stripe checkout session ID appended by Stripe on redirect. Not used (kept for URL compatibility).

check_out_cancel.doc: Stripe Checkout cancel return. UX-only: redirects the browser to the desk.

portal_return.doc: Stripe Billing Portal return. UX-only same-site bounce: redirects the browser to the desk so the SameSite=Strict session cookie survives the cross-site return (avoids apparent logout).
